name: clinic-protocol-decision-support
description: Produce protocol-bound clinical decision-support JSON for a synthetic FHIR-like clinic runtime. Use when a task supplies a target clinic case id (e.g. CASE-XXX-NNN) plus an answer_template.json schema and asks for one structured JSON assessment — adult respiratory / CAP, pediatric head injury, potassium repletion, serum-lab observation-window retrieval, or care-management routing — built strictly from a read-only clinic HTTP API. Triggers on prompts that say "synthetic clinic runtime", "<TASK_ENV_BASE_URL>", "conforms to input/payloads/answer_template.json", or "Return only a JSON object".
